# Adventis

> Adventis (legally Adventis L.L.C.-FZ) is a Dubai-based performance marketing agency providing paid media, programmatic advertising, influencer and celebrity marketing, sponsorships, analytics, AI-powered marketing solutions and specialist Filipino market expertise. Website: https://adventishub.com/

This file is a short guide to the public website. It summarises information that is published on the pages linked below; the HTML pages are the authoritative source.

## Core capabilities

- [Digital Advertising](https://adventishub.com/digital.html): paid media across search, video, display and programmatic
- [Celebrities & Influencers](https://adventishub.com/celebrities.html): influencer, creator and celebrity partnerships
- [Media & Sponsorship](https://adventishub.com/media.html): TV, radio, out-of-home, events and sponsorship
- [Analytics & Data Science](https://adventishub.com/analytics.html): measurement, tracking, dashboards and models
- [AI Performance Solutions](https://adventishub.com/ai.html): AI-powered optimisation and automation
- [Creative & Development](https://adventishub.com/creative.html): creative, landing pages and development
- [Gaming Partnerships](https://adventishub.com/gaming.html): streamers, in-game activations and tournaments

## Filipino market expertise

Adventis helps brands reach Filipino consumers through audience strategy, digital advertising, programmatic media, influencers, celebrity partnerships, events, sponsorships and community activations. Adventis is based in Dubai. Its Filipino audience strategies can cover the UAE, the wider GCC, the Philippines and relevant Filipino diaspora markets such as the United States and Canada. Adventis does not represent celebrity talent, has no Philippines office, and is not an agency for Filipino clients only.

- [Filipino Market & Diaspora Marketing Expertise](https://adventishub.com/filipinos.html): central page covering markets, digital advertising, influencers, celebrities, events, audience intelligence, experience and FAQ
